headline: 1 killed, 10 injured in clash over children's quarrel in Brahmanbaria
summary: A trivial dispute between two neighbors over their children's fight led to a violent confrontation in Bijoynagar, leaving one man dead and several others wounded.
details: A violent clash broke out in the Harashpur Bander Bari area of Bijoynagar upazila, Brahmanbaria, on Saturday morning, August 1.
The conflict started on Friday, July 31, when local residents Hamdu Mia and Yasin Mia engaged in a verbal altercation over a quarrel between two children.
The dispute escalated on Saturday morning when both parties attacked each other with indigenous weapons.
During the confrontation, Hamdu Mia was killed on the spot following an attack by Yasin and his associates.
At least 10 other people were injured in the clash and have been admitted to local hospitals and the district headquarters medical center.
Police arrived at the scene to bring the situation under control and have deployed additional forces to maintain peace in the area.
Bijoynagar Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Mohammad Ahsan Ullah confirmed the death and stated that legal action is being processed against those involved.
caption:
A children's fight led to a a fatal clash in Brahmanbaria, leaving one dead and 10 injured.

A violent clash broke out in the Harashpur Bander Bari area of Bijoynagar upazila, Brahmanbaria, on Saturday morning, August 1.

The conflict started on Friday, July 31, when local residents Hamdu Mia and Yasin Mia engaged in a verbal altercation over a quarrel between two children.

The dispute escalated on Saturday morning when both parties attacked each other with indigenous weapons.

During the confrontation, Hamdu Mia was killed on the spot following an attack by Yasin and his associates.

At least 10 other people were injured in the clash and have been admitted to local hospitals and the district headquarters medical center.

Police arrived at the scene to bring the situation under control and have deployed additional forces to maintain peace in the area.

Bijoynagar Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Mohammad Ahsan Ullah confirmed the death and stated that legal action is being processed against those involved.
